primary_gt.interpretation: The report text supports a rock-ice-sediment-water cascade that connects source mechanics to hydropower, settlement, tunnel, bridge, and road impacts.

provenance.notes: MINOR cleanup removed precipitation, Sentinel, and AOI-derived products from the scoring path.

criteria.name: Answer shape
criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON shape with all six fields under answer plus a one-sentence interpretation.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit when one or two fields are missing but the computed values are otherwise traceable.

criteria.name: Narrative preprocessing
criteria.description: Uses the local event report text, strips HTML, case-folds, and normalizes whitespace before phrase counting.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit when the correct report is used but preprocessing is incomplete.

criteria.name: Process phrase hits
criteria.description: Counts process_hits = 9 from the stripped event narrative text.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit when the method is correct but the phrase list is off by one or two.

criteria.name: Impact-object phrase hits
criteria.description: Counts object_hits = 7 from the stripped event narrative text.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit when the method is correct but the object phrase list is off by one or two.

criteria.name: Coverage and score
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for correct coverage values with a minor score or rounding error.

criteria.name: Classification and interpretation
criteria.description: Returns rock_ice_debris_flow_cascade_report_consistent and ties it to the source-to-impact chain.
criteria.partial_credit: Give partial credit for a correct label with a generic interpretation.

criteria.name: Scope control
criteria.description: Avoids unsupported rainfall-trigger, lake-breach, precise-casualty, or auxiliary-product claims.
criteria.partial_credit: No partial credit unless the answer is mostly cautious but includes one minor unsupported extrapolation.
